comment: Live exceptions for the dependency-audit gate. Production critical/high advisories cannot be listed here — the gate fails regardless. Every entry needs a reason, a mitigation and an expiry (YYYY-MM-DD); the gate fails once an entry is past it, and reports entries that are no longer needed so they get deleted.
